purpose: Validation re-run of the ad-aversion fix (PR #346, stimulus-affordance rendering). Measures whether a PRINCIPLED, gated rendering-fidelity fix moves the certified direction_accuracy=0.0 off the floor — WITHOUT any Hillstrom-specific or promo-specific rule.

config.ONLY_DIFFERENCE_FROM_BASELINE: SIDIRA_STIMULUS_AFFORDANCE=1 (the gated affordance clause is ON; identical config otherwise)

prediction.primary_success_criterion: direction_accuracy moves OFF 0.0 on BOTH conversion and visit — i.e. the affordance clause lets the blinded agent connect the email component to the site it opens, so at least some per-segment predicted signs flip to POSITIVE (matching the RCT, which shows emails RAISE outcomes).
prediction.point_prediction: direction_accuracy >= 0.5 on at least one outcome; both strictly > 0.0.
prediction.secondary: rank_rho (heterogeneity) MAY improve but we do NOT tune toward it and make no directional commitment on it.
prediction.gate: null-integrity certificate must PASS (8 cases, not underpowered) for the result to count.
honest_failure_modes: (a) direction_accuracy stays at/near 0.0 -> the bias is deeper than rendering fidelity; the fix did NOT work -> report the null, keep the gate OFF, escalate to Option B (elicitation anchor) or model comparison.
(b) all signs flip positive but heterogeneity rank_rho stays at chance -> partial win (direction fixed, who-responds-more still unsupported) -> report honestly.
(c) over-correction / cert voids -> report VOID, not trusted.

decision_rule.if_dir_acc_improves_both_cert_passes: the fix is validated on external RCT ground truth -> propose flipping the gate default ON (own PR + its own pre-registered evidence) -> this is a real, measured accuracy improvement = progress toward sellable.
decision_rule.if_dir_acc_flat: honest null -> the rendering hypothesis is wrong or insufficient -> next lever (Option B / stronger model).
decision_rule.report_either_way: append the delta to BENCHMARK_REPORT.md whether it flatters or not (the discipline is the safeguard against motivated reasoning).
